# Job Chapter 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 422v–423r

---

**19:1** And-answered Iyyov [Job] and-said:

**19:2** "Until when [ad anah] will-you-torment [togeyun] my-soul [nafshi] and-crush-me [utedakkeonani] with-words [bemillin]? **19:3** These ten-times [eser peamim] you-have-insulted-me [takhlimu]; are-you-not ashamed [lo teboshu] [that] you-deal-harshly [tahkeru] with-me?

**19:4** And-even-if [ve-af omnam] I-have-erred [shaghiti], with-me [itti] my-error [meshugati] lodges [talin]. **19:5** If indeed [im omnam] over-me you-magnify-yourselves [tagdilu], and-you-argue [vetokhichu] against-me my-reproach [cherpati],

**19:6** know then that God [eloah] has-wronged-me [ivvetani], and-his-net [umatsudo] upon-me he-has-closed [hiqqif].

**19:7** Behold, I-cry-out [ets'aq], 'Violence! [chamas]' and-I-am-not answered [velo e'eneh]; I-call-for-help [ashavvea'] and-there-is-no justice [mishpat].

**19:8** My-way [orchi] he-has-walled-up [gadar] and-I-cannot pass [velo e'evor], and-upon my-paths [netivotai] darkness [choshekh] he-sets [yasim]. **19:9** My-glory [kevodi] from-upon me he-has-stripped [hifshit], and-he-removed [vayyasar] the-crown [ateret] of-my-head [roshi].

**19:10** He-tears-me-down [yitteseni] all-around [saviv] and-I-go [va'elekh]; and-he-uproots [vayyassa'] like-a-tree [ka-ets] my-hope [tiqvati]. **19:11** And-he-kindles [vayyachar] against-me his-anger [appo] and-counts-me [vayyachsheveni] to-him as-his-enemy [ke-tsarav].

**19:12** Together [yachad] his-troops [gedudav] come [yavo'u] and-raise-up [vayyasollu] against-me their-way [darkham], and-encamp [vayyachanu] around [saviv] my-tent [le-aholi].

**19:13** My-brothers [achai] from-upon me he-has-put-far [hirchiq], and-my-acquaintances [yod'ai] surely [akh] are-estranged [zaru] from-me. **19:14** My-relatives [qerovai] have-failed [chadelu], and-my-close-friends [meyudda'ai] have-forgotten-me [shekhechuni].

**19:15** The-sojourners of-my-house [garei veiti] and-my-maidservants [ve-amhotai] count-me [tachshevuni] as-a-stranger [le-zar]; a-foreigner [nokhri] I-have-become in-their-eyes [be-eneihem]. **19:16** To-my-servant [le-avdi] I-call [qarati] and-he-does-not answer [velo ya'aneh]; with-my-mouth I-must-plead [etchannen] to-him.

**19:17** My-breath [ruchi] is-repulsive [zarah] to-my-wife [le-ishti], and-my-stench [ve-chanoti] to-the-sons of-my-womb [livnei vitni]. **19:18** Even young-boys [avilim] despise-me [ma'asu bi]; I-rise [aqumah] and-they-speak [vayedabberu] against-me. **19:19** All the-men of-my-council [metei sodi] abhor-me [tia'avuni], and-those I-loved [ve-zeh ahavti] have-turned [nehepkhu] against-me.

**19:20** To-my-skin [le-ori] and-to-my-flesh [livesari] my-bone [atsmi] clings [daveqah], and-I-escape [va'etmaltah] by-the-skin of-my-teeth [be-or shinnai].

**19:21** Have-mercy [chonnuni], have-mercy [chonnuni] on-me, you my-friends [re'ai], for the-hand of-God [eloah] has-struck-me [nag'ah bi].

**19:22** Why do-you-persecute-me [tirdofuni] like God [ke-el], and-from-my-flesh [umbesari] you-are-not satisfied [lo tisba'u]?

**19:23** Who-will-grant [mi yitten] now [efo] that-my-words [millai] were-written-down [veyikkatevun]! Who-will-grant that-in-a-record [bassefer] they-were-inscribed [yuchaqqu]! **19:24** With-a-pen [be-et] of-iron [barzel] and-lead [va-ofereth], forever [la'ad] in-the-rock [batsur] they-were-carved [yechatsevun]!

**19:25** And-I — I-know [yadati] [that] my-Redeemer [go'ali] lives [chai], and-[as the] last [ve-acharon] upon [the] dust [al afar] he-will-stand [yaqum].

**19:26** And-after [ve-achar] my-skin [ori] they-have-struck-off [niqqefu] this [zot], and-from-my-flesh [umbesari] I-will-see [echezeh] God [eloah]. **19:27** Whom I myself-will-see [echezeh ani] for-myself [li], and-my-eyes [ve-einai] will-see [ra'u] and-not a-stranger [ve-lo zar]. My-kidneys [kilyotai] are-consumed [kalu] in-my-bosom [becheqi].

**19:28** If you-say [tomeru], 'How [mah] shall-we-persecute-him [nirdof lo]?' and-the-root [shoresh] of-the-matter [davar] is-found [nimtsa] in-me — **19:29** fear [guru] for-yourselves from-the-sword [mecherev], for wrath [chemah] [brings] punishments of-the-sword [avonot cherev], that [lema'an] you-may-know [ted'un] [there is] judgment [shaddun]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.20 — "by the skin of my teeth":** This phrase (*be-or shinnai*) has entered English directly from Job. The meaning is debated — teeth have no skin, so Job may be saying he has escaped with nothing at all, or with the thinnest possible margin.

**v.25 — go'eli chai:** "My Redeemer lives" — *go'el* is a legal term for the kinsman-redeemer who avenges blood, redeems property, or vindicates a wronged relative (cf. Ruth 3-4; Leviticus 25:25). Job is claiming that someone — God? an angel? a future vindicator? — will stand on his behalf.

**v.26 — The most disputed verse in Job:** The Hebrew is extremely difficult. *Niqqefu* may mean "struck off" (destroyed) or "surrounded." *Umbesari* can mean "from my flesh" (after my flesh is destroyed) or "in/from my flesh" (while still embodied). The verse is either an affirmation of bodily resurrection or a vision of vindication after death — or beyond death. The text is genuinely ambiguous.

**v.17 — livnei vitni:** "Sons of my womb" — likely meaning "sons of my [mother's] womb," i.e., his own siblings. Some read it as "children of my body" (his own children), which creates a contradiction with 1:19 unless later children are implied.

*— EMET*
